entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Akihabara was lots of fun.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I think I wanna try going somewhere else[n]sometime.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...It really sounds like Sojiro wants me to[n]go back to school.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But online classes are better for studying![n]I wouldn't even have to leave the house.
That wouldn't solve anything.
That's a great idea.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Urgh... You're prolly right. Just studying[n]by myself is way different from actual[n]school.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ain't it!? I can attend classes without[n]even getting out of bed!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Though... I dunno if Sojiro'd really[n]consider that going to school.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: School...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Um, to be honest...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I really do wanna go back.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Do you think I'll be able to?
If we work together.[clr 27]
Want me to help?
I don't know.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Yeah!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Of course I do! You'd better not go back[n]on your word.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Right. I guess you couldn't know about[n]something that hasn't happened yet.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm gonna do my best!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh, I should make a promise list!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: My mom used to have me do that[n]all the time.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: She'd write all my goals for the month,[n]like cleaning the house or running[n]errands for her.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then when I'd finish one, she'd mark it off[n]with a big stamp.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: She always used to write comments too...[n]Those were the best.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh, and once I finished all my goals,[n]she would take a day off work to spend[n]time with me.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's decided then! I'm gonna make[n]a promise list!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Time to get my ideas ready!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...All done!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So, these are my promises.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 1. Go somewhere with lots of people.[n]Getting used to big crowds is key.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 2. Go to school. I wanna see what[n]the inside of a normal high school[n]looks like.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 3. Learn about my generation.[n]I definitely need more info...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 4. Have a normal conversation with[n]a stranger my age.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...How's that?
Sounds good to me.
Can you tell me again?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you want...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm not setting a deadline for this,[n]by the way. I wanna try and finish[n]all of them someday!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You're gonna have to help me though.[n]I'll work even harder with my navigation[n]in return!
I can sense Futaba's trust in me...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: S-So, um...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If I finish all the promises, do you think[n]I could have a reward?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I know it's kinda weird to ask... but[n]having a reward waiting at the finish[n]line will totally push me onward!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyway, I got this!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Though I'm kinda exhausted from[n]making the list, soooooo...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Tomorrow. I got this... tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Welp, I'm gonna make like a hedgehog[n]and roll outta here!
Futaba went home...
